detaileddescription.para: As documented at Ref.x equals() function: <quote> Specifically, two references are equal if they reference the same runtime object. Additionally, for optimization purposes, the runtime is *permitted* to indicate that two references to two separate runtime objects are equal, in the case where both references are to immutable objects whose structures are identical. </quote>
Note: this method is inherently native; it must be answered without calling any natural code

simplesect.para: true iff the identities are equal
